universe_note:
Chain-level campaign-v1 screen (identity_schema campaign-v1, scenario_id null), first run for this chain. Universe built per LINK across all 13 links, worked in priority order: the one money-corner link first, then the three CHOKE_POINT links, then the rest by chain position. The mapping (data/mappings/glp1-fill-finish.json, 14 listings, 16 placements) carries no fresh-context census audit at all (audit: null, status ACTIVE, never run), so every row this run must rest on Ron's 2026-09-01 PLACEMENT-scope rule: audit_scope "PLACEMENT" declared on the row, admitted only when the consumed placement's role evidence is entirely VERIFIED.

Two independent admissibility bars apply to every one of the mapping's 14 issuers, and this run found they do not currently overlap on a single one. Bar one, evidence tier: 5 of the 16 placements carry only VERIFIED evidence (CORNING/pharma-glass-tubing citing a Corning-Pfizer supply-agreement press release, STEVANATO-GROUP/primary-containment-converters and ATS-CORPORATION/device-assembly-automation and DR-REDDYS-LABORATORIES/generic-and-biosimilar-glp1-entrants each citing a Form 6-K exhibit, NOVO-NORDISK/glp1-demand-anchor citing a Form 6-K annual-report exhibit); the other 11 placements (WEST-PHARMACEUTICAL-SERVICES x2, GERRESHEIMER x2, STERIS, DANAHER, THERMO-FISHER-SCIENTIFIC, SIEGFRIED-HOLDING, BAXTER-INTERNATIONAL, BECTON-DICKINSON, HALOZYME-THERAPEUTICS) carry INFERRED evidence only (company blogs, product-launch and acquisition press releases, an IR press page) and are not admissible under the un-audited-mapping PLACEMENT rule. Bar two, profile availability: of the 14 mapped issuers, exactly 4 have a COMPLETE profile on disk (BECTON-DICKINSON, GERRESHEIMER, HALOZYME-THERAPEUTICS, WEST-PHARMACEUTICAL-SERVICES, all O2) and all four sit only on INFERRED-evidence placements. The 5 all-VERIFIED placements (CORNING, STEVANATO-GROUP, ATS-CORPORATION, DR-REDDYS-LABORATORIES, NOVO-NORDISK) have no profile on disk. Net effect: zero rows are seatable this run, on any of 13 links. This is a gate-driven finding, not an oversight or a gap in search: no row here weakens audit_scope PLACEMENT or accepts INFERRED evidence to force a seat.

autoinjector-and-pen-platforms [MONEY CORNER, UNDISCOVERED]: searched and empty. Four placements, BECTON-DICKINSON, WEST-PHARMACEUTICAL-SERVICES, GERRESHEIMER, HALOZYME-THERAPEUTICS, all ACTIVE and all backed by a COMPLETE O2 profile on disk, but every placement's role evidence is tagged INFERRED (a press release or company blog, not an SEC-filed exhibit), and the mapping carries no PASS census audit to admit INFERRED evidence at whole-mapping scope. This is the map's single money-corner link and its most heavily profiled link, and it is the one this run cannot seat a single name on: closing it needs either a fresh-context `run universe-audit glp1-fill-finish --placement <issuer_id>` on one or more of these four placements, or a whole-mapping PASS audit, neither of which is this run's stage or write scope.

elastomer-closure-components [CHOKE_POINT, CROWDED]: searched and empty. Sole placement WEST-PHARMACEUTICAL-SERVICES, ACTIVE, COMPLETE O2 profile, INFERRED evidence (a December 2025 company blog post) — the same evidence-tier block as the money-corner link above.

aseptic-filling-and-isolator-equipment [CHOKE_POINT, UNDISCOVERED]: searched and empty. Two placements, STERIS and DANAHER, both ACTIVE with INFERRED evidence (a 2021 product-launch release and a 2021 acquisition release respectively) and neither has a profile on disk: doubly blocked, on evidence tier and on profile availability.

sterile-fill-finish-capacity [CHOKE_POINT, UNDISCOVERED]: searched and empty. Three placements, THERMO-FISHER-SCIENTIFIC, SIEGFRIED-HOLDING, BAXTER-INTERNATIONAL, all ACTIVE with INFERRED evidence and none profiled: doubly blocked, the same as the link above.

pharma-glass-tubing [QUIET]: searched and empty. Sole placement CORNING, ACTIVE, all-VERIFIED evidence (a dated Corning/Pfizer Valor Glass supply-agreement press release), mechanically admissible — but no profile on disk. Admissible-but-unprofiled.

primary-containment-converters [EMERGING]: searched and empty. Sole placement STEVANATO-GROUP, ACTIVE, all-VERIFIED evidence (a Form 6-K exhibit, Q1 2026 results release), admissible, no profile. Admissible-but-unprofiled.

device-assembly-automation [QUIET]: searched and empty. Sole placement ATS-CORPORATION, ACTIVE, all-VERIFIED evidence (a Form 6-K exhibit, Q4 fiscal 2026 results release), admissible, no profile. Admissible-but-unprofiled.

generic-and-biosimilar-glp1-entrants [EMERGING]: searched and empty. Sole placement DR-REDDYS-LABORATORIES, ACTIVE, all-VERIFIED evidence (a Form 6-K exhibit announcing the generic semaglutide launch in Canada), admissible, no profile. Admissible-but-unprofiled.

glp1-demand-anchor [OVER_CROWDED]: searched and empty. Sole placement NOVO-NORDISK, ACTIVE, all-VERIFIED evidence (a Form 6-K annual-report/Q4 2025 financial-statement exhibit), admissible, no profile. Admissible-but-unprofiled. (LLY carries no mapped placement on this chain at all; only the NVO side of the demand anchor is mapped.)

ready-to-use-containment-formats [EMERGING]: searched and empty. Sole placement GERRESHEIMER, ACTIVE, COMPLETE O2 profile, INFERRED evidence (a January 2026 Pharmapack press page) — the same evidence-tier block as the money-corner link.

peptide-api-supply [HIGH criticality, EMERGING]: searched and empty. Zero mapped placements. None of the chain's own example_tickers for this link (BANB.SW, PPGN.SW, LONN.SW, 207940.KS, 2359.HK, TMO) appears in data/mappings/glp1-fill-finish.json; TMO is mapped only to sterile-fill-finish-capacity, a different link. This link needs a `run universe glp1-fill-finish` amendment before it can be screened at all, and it is the chain's one link with a dated lead-time figure (18 to 36 months for new reactor capacity), which makes the gap worth closing.

halobutyl-elastomer-feedstock [MEDIUM criticality, QUIET]: searched and empty. Zero mapped placements, by chain design: the chain's own note calls XOM/0386.HK/RELIANCE.NS "a trap: buying XOM is not buying GLP-1 capacity," and no listed pure play exists at this stage. Correctly un-mapped, not a gap.

us-onshoring-tariff-response [HIGH criticality, CROWDED]: searched and empty. Zero mapped placements, by chain design: example_tickers is deliberately empty (there is no instrument for a tariff schedule); the chain's own note routes the investable expression through the US-sited capacity at positions 4, 9 and 11 (primary-containment-converters, sterile-fill-finish-capacity, autoinjector-and-pen-platforms), each already covered above.

Net effect: 0 of 13 links produce rows this run (0 rows total). The money-corner link and all three CHOKE_POINT links are attributed as searched-and-empty with a stated reason, never silently absent. Three concrete next steps, none of them this run's to take: (a) `run profile <TICKER>` for GLW, STVN, ATS, RDY, NVO — five admissible, all-VERIFIED placements sitting unprofiled and blocking 5 of 13 links; (b) a fresh-context `run universe-audit glp1-fill-finish --placement <issuer_id>` (or a whole-mapping census audit) on BECTON-DICKINSON, WEST-PHARMACEUTICAL-SERVICES, GERRESHEIMER and HALOZYME-THERAPEUTICS to test whether their INFERRED role evidence upgrades to VERIFIED — this is the one action that could open the money corner, since all four already carry COMPLETE O2 profiles; (c) `run universe glp1-fill-finish` to close peptide-api-supply, which has zero mapped placements despite being a HIGH-criticality, dated-lead-time link. Not fixed here: data/mappings/ and data/companies/ are outside this run's write scope.
